entity1.name: Urban Legends
entity1.description: A collection of stories or beliefs that are widely circulated, often as warnings or anecdotes, and are considered part of modern folklore.;;;A contemporary form of folklore that includes stories, traditions, and beliefs passed down informally among people in urban settings.;;;Stories or beliefs that are spread by word of mouth or through media, often involving supernatural or mysterious elements and rooted in modern urban settings.;;;Stories or beliefs that spread through a population, often by word of mouth, and typically have a basis in real events but are exaggerated or distorted over time.;;;Stories or beliefs that spread widely, often through informal channels, and are typically regarded as untrue or exaggerated.;;;Contemporary traditional stories, beliefs, and practices that are passed down informally within a culture or society.

entity4.name: Haunted houses
entity4.description: Buildings or houses believed to be inhabited by ghosts or other supernatural entities, often featured in folklore and horror stories.;;;Buildings believed to be inhabited by ghosts or supernatural entities.;;;Buildings believed to be inhabited by ghosts or spirits, often associated with dark or tragic histories.

entity5.name: Mysterious creatures
entity5.description: Unidentified or legendary beings that are often part of folklore, urban legends, or supernatural tales.;;;Phenomena or beings that are beyond the laws of nature and often involve magical or otherworldly elements.;;;Unidentified or supernatural beings that are often the subject of folklore and horror stories.;;;Refers to phenomena or entities that are beyond the laws of nature and often associated with the paranormal or mystical.;;;Relating to events by which natural laws are apparently violated, or to beings or phenomena beyond the laws of nature.

entity6.name: urban legends
entity6.description: Stories or beliefs that are widely circulated but often unverified, typically involving elements of mystery, horror, or the supernatural.;;;Stories that are passed down through generations, often involving supernatural or unexplained events, and are associated with urban settings.;;;Stories or beliefs that are spread through informal channels, often involving mysterious or unexplained events.;;;Stories or myths that are spread through word of mouth or media, often containing elements of horror, mystery, or caution.;;;Stories or beliefs that spread widely, often through informal channels, and are typically exaggerated or false.;;;Stories or beliefs that are widely circulated but often unverified, typically involving exaggerated or fictional elements.;;;Stories or beliefs that are widely circulated, often with exaggerated or fictional elements, and are typically passed down through informal channels.;;;Stories or myths that are spread through word of mouth or digital media, often involving supernatural or unexplained elements and set in modern times.;;;Stories or beliefs that are widely circulated but often unverified, typically involving elements of mystery or horror.

entity8.name: ancient times

entity11.name: Hook Man
